title.v: Khai báo người sử dụng cho nhân viên

subtitle.v: Thêm, sửa, phân quyền người sử dụng...

query.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @ma_nv varchar(32), @admin int select top 1 @ma_nv = username from sysuserinfo where user_id = @@userId set @strKey= ' username in (select username from vdmnv)'
IF @@admin = 1 BEGIN exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysuserinfo b on a.parent_user = b.user_id', 'b.username as parent_username', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId END ELSE BEGIN set @strKey =' username = '''+@ma_nv+''' ' exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysuserinfo b on a.parent_user = b.user_id', 'b.username as parent_username', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId
END

request.text:
declare @r as nvarchar(1000) select @r = ''
if @@admin = 0 select @r = N'AdminAccess' if exists(select 1 from sysuserinfo where admin = 1 and user_id = @user_id) select @r = N'NotAuthorized' select @r as result
